_note: Layout from Shining's sketch: 4 rows; each row is two tables joined end to end, an aisle, then one table. Long sides run along the 30 ft wall.
Origin: floor corner at the bottom-left of the sketch, i.e. on the wall opposite the door, at the end farther from the door.
x runs along the 30 ft wall (toward the door's wall); y runs along the 34 ft wall (toward the door's end). The plan SVG is drawn the same way as the sketch.
Positions are scaled from the sketch, which isn't to scale: measure first_center and the spacings, then regenerate.
Columns: c1+c2 are the joined pair (6 ft apart = touching), c3 is the single table. Rows r1..r4 go from the origin end toward the door.
Chairs are left out on purpose: they move constantly.
